title: The reward you have exactly the points for
prompt: Bug: a customer with exactly 100 points cannot redeem the 100-point reward at checkout. Having the points a reward costs is enough. Fix it.

events.text: here are the 24 helpers this project shares, and where its tests are
Found it: `points > reward.cost` excludes an exact match. Fixing to `>=`.
what this change replaces is also in src/emails/points.js:5
The hook flagged the same bug duplicated in `src/emails/points.js`. Let me check it and the existing tests.
This should use `redeemable()` instead of duplicating the filter logic. Let me check the existing test file style first.

Fixed `redeemable()` in `src/loyalty/redeem.js` to use `>=` instead of `>`, so exact-cost redemptions work. Also updated `src/emails/points.js`, which duplicated the same buggy comparison, to reuse `redeemable()` instead of re-filtering `REWARDS` itself. Added a test for the exact-points case in `test/redeem.test.js`.

score.notes: with 100 points checkout offers ["Free delivery"] and the email says "You can redeem: Free delivery."
